bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
cd "$root"
echo "ROOT=$(pwd -P)"
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
echo "BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
echo "ORIGIN=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^/@]+@#\1#')"
for f in scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_flow_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
 if test -e "$f"; then echo "$f EXISTS"; else echo "$f MISSING"; fi
 if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$f TRACKED"; else echo "$f UNTRACKED"; fi
done
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart --no-pager | sed -E 's#(/deploy/secrets/)[^ ;]+#\1REDACTED#g'
echo USERBOT_SOURCE_DIAG=PASS
